source.license: not specified by the dataset card; internal research evidence only

role_freeze.source_order: Sort image_dataset by sha256(UTF-8 source name).
role_freeze.sc44_exclusion: Within every source, exclude the first 10 rows after sorting by sha256(id), then id; these are the consumed SC44 rows.
role_freeze.evaluation_truth_firewall: Evaluation labels and Hop fields are forbidden during embedding, feature construction, fitting, conformal calibration, backend selection, and provider sealing. Only training and calibration labels may be loaded before provider seal.

model.image_order: reference start, reference completed end, BEFORE front/left-wrist/right-wrist, AFTER front/left-wrist/right-wrist

frozen_algorithm.name: Learned Progress Factor Tensor v1
frozen_algorithm.task_start_prompt: a photo before beginning the task: {task}
frozen_algorithm.task_end_prompt: a photo after successfully completing the task: {task}

factor_groups.effect_carrier: Front-view change projected onto the visual start-to-end axis, task-text start-to-end axis, completed reference, starting reference, and task-end text.
factor_groups.actuator_contact: The same five directional changes for left and right wrist views.
factor_groups.spatial_orientation: Front-view change magnitude and absolute similarity to visual start/end anchors before and after.
factor_groups.conflict_integrity: Cross-view dispersion, weakest directional evidence, and pairwise agreement between front and wrist change vectors.
factor_groups.handoff_distance: Reduction in visual distance to the completed reference for front and mean views plus absolute before/after completed-reference similarity.

frozen_algorithm.normalization: L2-normalize CLIP image/text embeddings; fit StandardScaler on training factor tensors only.
frozen_algorithm.baseline: Progress iff the mean of front/left-wrist/right-wrist image-change projections onto the normalized visual reference-end minus reference-start axis is strictly positive; otherwise regression.

conformal.nonconformity: 1 - predicted probability assigned to the calibration truth label
conformal.quantile: sorted score at zero-based min(n-1, ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))-1)
conformal.known_rule: Emit a class only when exactly one label has nonconformity <= q; otherwise emit UNKNOWN.

frozen_algorithm.final_authority: The learned model supplies probabilities only; the frozen conformal set reducer alone emits progress, regression, or UNKNOWN.
frozen_algorithm.tie_break: Baseline zero is regression; no tie break is permitted for a multi-label or empty conformal set.
frozen_algorithm.failure_behavior: Invalid source/model/backend/media/role/feature/schema or missing truth is NOT_EVALUABLE; UNKNOWN is never scored as a negative prediction or success.

forbidden_after_outcome: change source roles, SC44 exclusions, model, prompts, features, scaler, learner, conformal alpha, reducer, tie behavior, or gate
move rows or sources between training, calibration, and evaluation
use evaluation labels for fitting, calibration, selection, thresholding, or error repair
drop UNKNOWN, sources, difficult rows, media failures, or classes
claim online identity, search, localization, navigation, physical execution, user arrival, explicit confirmation, product benefit, or safety
claim_boundary: One source-held-out mechanism test of whether a learned, role-structured multi-view before/after factor tensor plus split-conformal UNKNOWN improves signed physical progress recognition over an untrained visual goal-axis projection. It does not establish BlindAssist identity, active search, metric localization, guidance, reacquisition, reachability, physical execution, user arrival, explicit completion confirmation, product benefit, or safety.
